name: open-kimi-ppt-skill
tagline: Unofficial Kimi Slides skill for AI agents — generate editable PPTD + PPTX with a local browser editor
description: open-kimi-ppt-skill is an unofficial Kimi Slides skill that lets AI agents generate editable PPTD and PPTX presentations, complete with a local browser editor for tweaking slides after generation. It mirrors the workflow behind Kimi's popular slides feature but keeps it open and agent-native, so any compatible agent can produce deck files that stay editable rather than locked-in exports.
highlights: Agent-generated PPTD and PPTX files that remain fully editable
Local browser editor for post-generation slide tweaks
Unofficial open re-implementation of the Kimi Slides agent workflow
1.6k stars even after the repo was archived
curatorNote: Worth tracking despite being archived — the pattern it established (agents producing editable decks plus a local editor) is the template for agentic document tools. The archived status is a caution flag, so treat it as reference material rather than an active dependency.
